questdb_build: Build Information: QuestDB 10.0.1, JDK 25.0.2, Commit Hash 7a391566ac827e0d8c269b91f2415c16b0a32a84
top_level_shape: two row projections UNION ALL; LEFT JOIN plus grouped suspension; ASOF fallback path; no outer time aggregation
reason: Official QuestDB 10.0.1 creation validator requires a SAMPLE BY or timestamp_floor-based grouped interval, WAL base and designated timestamp for every refresh mode; nested suspension grouping does not satisfy the whole row-enrichment definition.
recommended_path: Reuse existing backtest_daily composite-key materialized table and canonical Java SQL window job; retain v_backtest_daily 13-column alias and formal read guards. Explicitly describe this as table materialization, not native MV.
strict_native_mv_alternative: First publish complete unique(date,code) rows into existing backtest_daily; then an explicitly verified per-stock daily singleton aggregate native MV, read by v_backtest_daily alias. Extra storage/refresh stage; not installed or validated in this audit.
existing_native_mvs:
SELECT
    trade_date,
    count() AS stock_count,
    sum(CASE WHEN pct_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_count,
    sum(CASE WHEN pct_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_count,
    sum(CASE WHEN pct_change = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flat_count,
    avg(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change,
    sum(amount) / 100000.0 AS total_amount_yi
FROM stk_factor

critical_constraints: Preserve 13 fields, complete composite key, is_suspended LONG and is_st INT.
Preserve no-factor suspension rows, prior-close ASOF, source units and NULL semantics.
ASOF source pin includes prior price history, not only current date partitions.
Existing NativeDailyWindowWritePort is day-only, 10000-row snapshot, MONTH/nonDEDUP: cannot directly handle this data.
Current breadth/retail MVs invalid; exact aliases can be valid while their MVs invalid; guard must still reject.
Coordinate Python existing CREATE OR REPLACE installer so it cannot silently revert the new materialized alias.
Versioned cache/coverage already exists; preserve provenance and source-generation digest contract.
Use existing runner/batch/locks/publication journal; all-key/field readback and WAL settled checks before publishing.
Window replacement must remove obsolete keys; ordinary UPSERT alone cannot remove vanished source rows.
Do not use last/max aggregation to hide upstream duplicates or treat REFRESH acknowledgement/maxDate as completeness.
